act.name: Right to Information Act, 2005
act.source_authority: Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India
act.description: Central law enabling citizens to request information from public authorities and appeal refusals or delay.

sections.title: Disposal of request.
sections.text: Section 7 governs the time and manner in which an information request is decided.
sections.plain_language_summary: The public information officer must decide an RTI request within the statutory period and communicate fees, the decision, or reasons for refusal.
